concerns.text: "FR-001: System MUST download and parse raw CSV files from the **Battery Archive dataset** (batteryarchive.org, DOI), which provides real, publicly available voltage, current, temperature time‑series and capacity measurements for cells cycled under multiple protocols, filtering for cells with complete cycling histories and known end‑of‑life capacity. No other dataset source may be substituted." This requirement is untestable because the specification does not provide a verified programmatic download endpoint or a concrete URL for the Battery Archive dataset. Without a reachable source, the downstream functional requirements (FR‑001, FR‑011, FR‑012) and success criteria (SC‑001, SC‑004‑SC‑007, SC‑009, SC‑010) cannot be exercised in an automated test.
